content.p: This Act is the Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Amendment (Indigenous Land Corporation) Act 2018.

Each provision of this Act specified in column 1 of the table commences, or is taken to have commenced, in accordance with column 2 of the table. Any other statement in column 2 has effect according to its terms.

tr.td: 1. Sections 1 to 3 and anything in this Act not elsewhere covered by this table
The day this Act receives the Royal Assent.

A single day to be fixed by Proclamation. However, if the provisions do not commence within the period of 6 months beginning on the day this Act receives the Royal Assent, they commence on the day after the end of that period.
At the same time as the provisions covered by table item 2.

At the same time as the provisions covered by table item 2. However, the provisions do not commence at all if Schedule 1 to the Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Land and Sea Future Fund (Consequential Amendments) Act 2018 commences at or before that time.

content.p: Note: This table relates only to the provisions of this Act as originally enacted. It will not be amended to deal with any later amendments of this Act.
Any information in column 3 of the table is not part of this Act. Information may be inserted in this column, or information in it may be edited, in any published version of this Act.

Legislation that is specified in a Schedule to this Act is amended or repealed as set out in the applicable items in the Schedule concerned, and any other item in a Schedule to this Act has effect according to its terms.

content.p: acquisition functions has the meaning given by subsection 191D(1).
indigenous waters means water, or waters, in relation to which water-related rights are held by:
an Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander corporation; or
an Aboriginal person or a Torres Strait Islander;
(whether or not water-related rights in relation to the water or waters are held by any other person).
internal waters of Australia has the same meaning as in the Seas and Submerged Lands Act 1973.
management functions has the meaning given by subsection 191E(1).
national indigenous land and sea strategy means the strategy prepared under section 191N.

content.p: water-related right has the meaning given by section 4C.

(1) A water-related right means any legal or equitable right or interest in, or in relation to, water or waters (including the internal waters of Australia) within the outer limits of the exclusive economic zone of Australia.
(2) A right to do any of the following is an example of a water-related right:
undertake an activity in or on waters.
A reference in this section to water includes surface water and ground water.

In performing its acquisition functions, the Indigenous Land and Sea Corporation must search any relevant Registers of the National Native Title Tribunal to ascertain whether any claims have been lodged or accepted or determined in relation to:
land under consideration for acquisition; or
waters, in relation to which water-related rights are under consideration for acquisition.
to carry on, or arrange for the carrying on of, management activities in relation to indigenous waters;
to carry on, or arrange for the carrying on of, management activities in relation to water, or waters, in relation to which the Indigenous Land Corporation holds water-related rights;
to make grants of money for the carrying on of management activities in relation to indigenous-held land and indigenous waters;
to make loans of money (whether secured or unsecured) for the purpose of carrying on management activities in relation to indigenous-held land and indigenous waters;
to guarantee loans made for the purpose of carrying on management activities in relation to indigenous-held land and indigenous waters.
Note 4: Indigenous waters is defined by section 4.
Management activities relating to indigenous waters

Paragraph (1)(ca) does not authorise the Indigenous Land and Sea Corporation to carry on a management activity in relation to indigenous waters in a manner inconsistent with the rights and interests of other persons.
management activities means activities that consist of, or relate to, the managed use, care or improvement of land, water or waters, and includes the following:
carrying on a business that involves the use, care or improvement of land, water or waters;
providing any of the following services (whether on a commercial basis or otherwise) in connection with a business that involves the use, care or improvement of land, water or waters:
providing environmental management services (whether on a commercial basis or otherwise) in relation to the use, care or improvement of land, water or waters;
providing training (whether on a commercial basis or otherwise) in the skills and knowledge relevant to:
the carrying on of a business that involves the use, care or improvement of land, water or waters; or
the managed use, care or improvement of land, water or waters;
disseminating information (whether on a commercial basis or otherwise) about:
land management practices and water management practices; and
environmental management practices relating to land, water or waters.

hcontainer.name: schedule
hcontainer.heading: Renaming body as Indigenous Land and Sea Corporation

hcontainer.name: amendedAct
hcontainer.heading: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Act 2005

content.p: Indigenous Land and Sea Corporation means the corporation referred to in section 191A.
Indigenous Land and Sea Corporation Board means the Board of Directors referred to in section 191V.
Indigenous Land and Sea Corporation Chairperson means the Chairperson referred to in section 191V.
Indigenous Land and Sea Corporation Chief Executive Officer means the Chief Executive Officer referred to in section 192K.
Indigenous Land and Sea Corporation Director means a member of the Indigenous Land and Sea Corporation Board.
(b) definition of Indigenous Land Corporation Board;
(c) definition of Indigenous Land Corporation Chairperson;
(d) definition of Indigenous Land Corporation Chief Executive Officer;
(e) definition of Indigenous Land Corporation Director.
The corporation that was established under this section as previously in force by the name Indigenous Land Corporation is now to be known as the Indigenous Land and Sea Corporation.
Note: Subsection 25B(1) of the Acts Interpretation Act 1901 provides that a body whose name is altered by an Act continues in existence under the new name so that its identity is not affected.

hcontainer.name: item
hcontainer.heading: Subsection 193R(1) (paragraphs (a) and (c) of the definition of exempt matter)

content.p: who is or has been an Indigenous Land and Sea Corporation Director or an acting Indigenous Land and Sea Corporation Director; or
who is or has been the Indigenous Land and Sea Corporation Chief Executive Officer or an acting Indigenous Land and Sea Corporation Chief Executive Officer; or
who is or has been employed or engaged under section 192S or 192V; or
who is performing, or who has performed, duties on behalf of the Indigenous Land and Sea Corporation under an arrangement under section 192T; or
whose services are being, or have been, made available to the Indigenous Land and Sea Corporation under an arrangement under section 192U; or
who is or has been a director or employee of a subsidiary of the Indigenous Land and Sea Corporation.
(1A) A person who was covered by the definition of ILC officer as in force immediately before this subsection commenced is covered by the definition of ILSC officer.

Note: This is intended to make it clear that any person who held an office, or undertook any other role, covered by the definition at a time when the corporation had its original name of the Indigenous Land Corporation, is still an ILSC officer. See also subsection 25B(1) of the Acts Interpretation Act 1901.
